title: Three mock tool bars give one key to two different tools
goal: On three screens of the design study, two buttons sitting in the same tool bar claim the same keyboard letter, so one of them can never be reached from the keyboard. Pick a letter for each so every tool in a bar has its own.
notes: Found while fixing the redline Arrow key. Same-bar collisions: docs/design/mocks/pages/image.html Patch (P) sits next to Pen (P) - Photoshop files Patch under J with the healing group, and Heal (J) already exists in the corpus, so the fix is probably Patch -> J as a grouped slot. iconography.html Marquee (M) next to Measure (M) - the app already resolved this one, Tool.shortcutKey has measure on I because M is the Photoshop marquee. ui-prototype.html Connect (X) next to Swap foreground and background (X). Detection script: grep title="...(K)" per page and group by K. Note app-shell.html and lang-toolbars.html also flag but are false positives - they render several DIFFERENT tool bars on one page as a gallery, so C=Crop in an image bar vs C=Component insert in a UI bar is mode-dependent, not a collision. Canonical letters now live in Sources/PhotonzCore/Tools.swift Tool.shortcutKey and the rule is written up in docs/design/mocks/shared/AGENTS.md.
acceptance: No tool bar in the design study has two controls whose key hint is the same letter
The letters that change still follow Photoshop wherever Photoshop has the same tool
The keyboard legend page lists whatever letters changed

log.note: Epic design-system is staged next, not now. Kept it: it is a small conformance fix that also lands a permanent guard, and it was already claimed. Recorded rather than dropped.

Adversarial review before building. (1) The task's grep found 3 collisions; a bar-scoped detector found 5, and cleared app-shell.html and lang-toolbars.html as galleries of different mode bars, as the notes predicted. (2) image.html had already half-solved Patch/Pen by silently deleting Pen's key from the overflow menu, so the bar's tooltip promised P and its own menu showed nothing. Worse than the collision. (3) Photoshop puts Patch in Heal's J group, one slot with a flyout, so the two cannot both print a bare J; the honest answer is the shifted sibling, and capture-wt.html already prints Redact (shift-R). (4) Connect has no Photoshop equivalent and no entry in Tool.shortcutKey, so its letter is free; X is swap foreground/background on 44 pages, so Connect moves, not X. Free letters corpus-wide were D, N, Q, Y, and only N ties to the name. (5) Nothing here is decorative; shortest version is five attribute edits.

Built: iconography.html Measure M -> I; image.html Patch P -> shift-J plus Pen's P restored in the overflow menu; ui-prototype.html Connect X -> N; agent.html and export-share.html overflow rows renamed Component -> Component insert to match the button they stand for. lang-keyboard.html Tools legend gained Measure I, Connect N, Heal J, Patch shift-J plus a paragraph explaining the group idiom. shared/AGENTS.md rewritten to name the checker and spell out the shifted-sibling and one-name rules.

New guard: docs/design/mocks/shared/check-shortcuts.mjs walks every .tbar in pages/, reads the letters its buttons and overflow menu print, and fails on a same-bar duplicate. Was 5 red, now green. check-elevation.mjs and check-states.mjs still green; Scripts/test.sh 1094 tests pass.

Encoding gotcha for future runs: perl -0pi without -CSD double-encodes an entire UTF-8 file the moment the replacement introduces a wide character. It silently rewrote 51 lines of image.html before git diff caught it. Reverted and redid with python3. Use python3 for any edit that inserts a glyph.

Second adversarial pass on the rendered pages. Overflow menu on image.html reads Heal J / Patch shift-J two rows apart and the group is legible; the shifted keycap right-aligns with the plain letters without disturbing them. The DS tooltip upgrade takes up to 12 characters inside the parens, so shift-J flows through as data-tip="Patch|shift-J" exactly like the existing chord tooltips. Left rough: the ruler still says M on 59 pages while the app and iconography.html say I, and a blind sweep collides with the eyedropper in icon-gradient-wt.html, so that fork is filed as its own task. Also found and filed: lang-keyboard.html's Components card clips its key badges by 16px, pre-existing.

Every tool bar in the design study now gives each key to exactly one tool. iconography.html Measure M->I, image.html Patch P->shift-J with Pen's P restored in the overflow menu, ui-prototype.html Connect X->N, plus two overflow rows renamed to match the button they stand for. New guard shared/check-shortcuts.mjs walks every .tbar and fails on a same-bar duplicate: was 5 red, now green. Keyboard legend and shared/AGENTS.md updated. Verified in the browser on all five pages; Scripts/test.sh 1094 tests pass. Pushed as 4ad74e7.
